name: How does clear floor space affect accessible kitchen outlet placement?

mainEntity.name: How does clear floor space affect accessible kitchen outlet placement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear floor space is critical for accessible kitchen outlet placement as it ensures a person using a wheelchair or other mobility aid can approach and use the outlet. A minimum of 30 inches by 48 inches of clear floor space must be provided in front of the outlet, allowing for either a forward or parallel approach. This space must be free of obstructions to facilitate safe and independent access.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear floor space (minimum 30x48 inches) ensures a person using a wheelchair can approach and use the outlet without obstruction.
